headline: DDG and YK Osiris’ camps had multiple heated exchanges at Adin Ross’ Brand Risk 16 boxing
body: DDG and YK Osiris’ camps had multiple heated exchanges at Adin Ross’ Brand Risk 16 boxing event, with security repeatedly stepping in to keep things from escalating. Tensions flared again during the fight after a member of YK Osiris’ crew threatened to take DDG’s Richard Mille watch off his wrist. “Take it off my wrist, ni**a! You gon’ die! ” DDG fired back. Streamer Deshae Frost went on to score a TKO victory over YK Osiris.
